scope: Media-only recovery for canonical/provisional learner pages with no displayable gallery images; scientific and range state remain unchanged.

protected_scope.ulmus: Owned by the separate user-authorized elm photo repair lane; do not duplicate.
protected_scope.saved_joey_frames: Accepted saved Joey frame overlap is already exhausted; only explicitly rejected blurry frames remain excluded.

selection_rules: Check existing canonical assets, research drafts, curation archive/inbox, Joey archive, and saved frames before new searching.
Prefer complementary diagnostic views over generic beauty shots.
Keep exact taxon identity, creator, source page, license/reuse status, and diagnostic role with every selected image.
For the private learner, private-study imagery may be used with public_reuse=false; do not imply publication rights.
Do not alter taxonomy or range decisions as part of photo recovery.

targets.source: Joey Santore / Crime Pays But Botany Doesn't — South Texas Borderlands
targets.rights: private study; public reuse not cleared
targets.verification: Canonical species JSON now has three gallery entries and curation_status photo_files_present=3; batch archived successfully.

existing_exact_candidate.source: Joey Santore / Crime Pays But Botany Doesn't — Puebla gallery
existing_exact_candidate.rights: private study; public reuse not cleared
existing_exact_candidate.caution: Use as morphology material only; do not use this out-of-region image as range evidence.

targets.remaining_visual_need: Prefer one target-zone Texas view that clearly shows the strongly curved downward prickles and low pinna/leaflet counts; retain fruit/pod coverage.

fast_fill_policy.priority: broad usable learner coverage before final photo polish
fast_fill_policy.initial_target: about 3 useful exact-species photos when practical: habit, reproductive structure, and identification structure
source_order: existing project photos and already-recorded exact media
exact-species iNaturalist photos with licenses permitting noncommercial use
other clearly licensed exact-species sources when useful
fast_fill_policy.skip: all-rights-reserved images and permission-seeking during fast-fill
fast_fill_policy.provisional_learner_ready_note: Presentation may be incomplete; taxonomy/range uncertainty must not be presented as confirmed.
fast_fill_policy.workflow: Check manifest, claims, and exact records being edited; commit small durable batches; move on.
